parameters.name: lf_mp_id

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/accounts/{malo_id}/ledger` — the newest movements with the
balance the window opens at (`crate::reads::ledger`, shared with MCP

parameters.name: lf_mp_id
parameters.description: The Lieferant's MP-ID the account is kept under; defaults to the tenant.

parameters.name: limit

Maximum movements, newest first (default 100, at most 1000); what is

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/dunning` — the open dunning cases, newest Mahnung first
(`crate::reads::dunning`, shared with MCP `list_dunning`).

`GET /api/v1/offene-posten` — the accounts with an open balance, largest

parameters.name: min_balance_eur
parameters.description: Minimum balance in EUR, as a decimal string (e.g. `"1.99"`). Default: 1 ct minimum.

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/payments/match` — the accounts an incoming payment may
belong to (`crate::reads::payment_match`, shared with MCP
`suggest_payment_match`). Reads only; booking is the camt import or a
manual Buchung.
post.description:
A read posted as a body because it carries the payer's IBAN: in a query
string the IBAN lands in every access log and trace span that records the
URI, which is personal data no log may hold.

422.description: A body that is not a payment to match

parameters.name: limit

200.description: Active plants whose Förderung ends within the horizon

Abrechnungsmonat, 1–12. A month without a year narrows every year to

`GET /api/v1/malos`

parameters.name: rollencodenummer
parameters.description: Filter by `rollencodenummer` (GLN) in active role assignments.

parameters.name: fallgruppe

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/malos/:id`
`GET /api/v1/malos/{id}/lokationsbuendel?stichtag=YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: stichtag
parameters.description: The date the bündel is resolved for (YYYY-MM-DD)

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/melos/:id`

put.description:
# Single-write-path invariant (MaLo ↔ MeLo)

This PUT is the only writer of the `melo.malo_id` FK, and the repository
maintains the corresponding `melo → malo` edge in the temporal
`lokationszuordnungen` graph in the same transaction: the graph is always a
superset of the FK (the FK is a derived convenience for "current parent"),
and reparenting closes the previous open edge (`valid_to`). See
`marktd::pg::melo` for the reconciliation rules.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/melos/:id/standorteigenschaften`
get.description:
Returns the typed BO4E `Standorteigenschaften` for the MeLo — carrying
`StandorteigenschaftenStrom` (regelzone EIC, bilanzierungsgebietEic) and/or
`StandorteigenschaftenGas` (druckstufe). Required for Redispatch 2.0
`NetworkConstraintDocument` cross-references and Gas billing zone routing.

Returns 404 when the MeLo has no `standorteigenschaften` column populated yet.
Use `PUT /api/v1/melos/{id}` with a `data.standorteigenschaften` field to populate it.

404.description: MeLo not found or no Standorteigenschaften

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/msb-rahmenvertraege` — list conclusion records.

put.description:
Idempotent on the natural key `(sparte, nb_mp_id, msb_mp_id, valid_from)`;
the record id stays stable across re-submits. A non-zero `version` in the
body acts as an optimistic-locking guard. The row and its CloudEvent
commit in one transaction.

200.description: Upserted; returns stable id and new version

412.description: Supplied version does not match the stored version

422.description: An invalid window, a Strom row with a Gas-only status, or a window overlapping another contract of the same parties and Sparte

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/msb-rahmenvertraege/check` — is a contract `abgeschlossen`
and valid on `datum`?
get.description:
Always `200` with a Befund: `abgeschlossen: false` names why (no contract,
only offered, to be adapted, ended). A database failure is `500`, never a
`false` — an outage is not evidence that no contract exists.

parameters.name: nb_mp_id
parameters.description: The NB's MP-ID in that Sparte

parameters.name: datum
parameters.description: The day the contract must be valid on (YYYY-MM-DD)

400.description: A missing or malformed query parameter

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/msb-rahmenvertraege/{id}` — fetch one record.
`GET /api/v1/netzzugang/antraege` — list requests.
`GET /api/v1/netzzugang/antraege/{id}` — fetch a request.

patch.description:
Used by the makod sender (`uebermittelt`/`fehlgeschlagen`) and by the
operator or answer channel (`bestaetigt`/`abgelehnt`).

412.description: expected_version does not match the stored version

post.description:
Enqueue immediate (re-)dispatch of the latest PRICAT version for the given NB
to all currently active LF partners.

The actual dispatch happens asynchronously in the background. Returns `202
Accepted` with the version ID that was queued.

Use this endpoint to manually trigger dispatch after an AS4 connectivity
incident, or to force re-distribution to newly on-boarded LF partners without
waiting for the next scheduled scan.

parameters.name: nb_mp_id
parameters.description: NB GLN to dispatch PRICAT for

404.description: No PRICAT version found for this NB

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/pricat/{nb_mp_id}/dispatch-log/{version_id}`
get.description:
Returns the dispatch audit log for a specific PRICAT version — one entry per
LF partner that was reached (or attempted).

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/pricat/{nb_mp_id}/history`
get.description:
Returns all versioned PRICAT snapshots for the given NB GLN, newest first.
Each entry includes dispatch state so operators can monitor the pipeline.

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/versorgung/{malo_id}` — the current supply state, or with
`?at=YYYY-MM-DD` the state as of that German calendar day.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description:
Point-in-time date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (German local time, i.e. CET/CEST).

When present, returns the supply state as it was at end-of-day on this date,
reconstructed from the history log.  Omit for the current state.

200.description: The supply state; `ETag` carries its version

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/versorgung/{malo_id}/history` — the supply-state change
history, newest first, paged.

accountingd.Kontoauszug.description:
A statement window (`list_ledger`, `GET /api/v1/accounts/{malo_id}/ledger`):
`opening_ct` plus every `signed_ct` is the newest line's `running_ct`.

lf_mp_id.description: The Lieferant's MP-ID the account is kept under.

opening_ct.description:
The signed balance the window opens at, in cents — what was booked
before it and what `limit` cut off its front.

amount_ct.description: The movement in cents, always positive; `side` carries the sign.

beleg.description: The Beleg the booking cites — a Rechnungsnummer, a bank reference.

running_ct.description: The running balance after this movement, in cents.

signed_ct.description: Signed contribution to the balance (debit +, credit −), in cents.

balance_ct.description: Open-items balance in cents: positive is owed, negative a Guthaben.

balance_eur.description: `balance_ct` as a decimal EUR string, e.g. `"-12.50"`.

lf_mp_id.description: The Lieferant's MP-ID the account is kept under.

faelle.description: The open cases, newest Mahnung first.

saturated.description: The page is full: more cases may be open than were listed.

account_id.description: The customer account it was opened on.

amount_due_ct.description: The amount the Mahnung demands, in cents.

due_date.description: The payment date the Mahnung sets.

sperrauftrag_ce_id.description: The CloudEvent id of the Sperrauftrag a Mahnstufe 3 raised, if any.

accountingd.PaymentMatchParams.description:
`suggest_payment_match`'s parameters — the body of
`POST /api/v1/payments/match`. It reads and books nothing.

`Debug` leaves the IBAN out: a payment to match is logged, if ever, by its
amount and reference, never by the payer's account.

amount_ct.description: Payment amount in 1/100 EUR cents (e.g. 12500 = 125.00 EUR).

end_to_end_id.description: `EndToEndId`, when the bank echoed one back.

iban.description:
Counterparty IBAN, when the bank reported one — the strongest evidence
of who paid, and the rung that resolves without any guessing.

reference.description: Payment reference / Verwendungszweck from the bank statement.

tolerance_pct.description:
Fuzzy tolerance for the fallback rung: how many percent the open balance
may deviate from the payment (default 2 %). Ignored when the reference
identifies the account outright.

accountingd.Saldostatus.description:
Where an account's balance stands: `overdue` — the customer owes
(`balance_ct > 0`); `credit` — a Guthaben (`balance_ct < 0`); `settled` —
nothing is open.

accountingd.UeberfaelligeKonten.description:
The accounts with an open balance (`list_overdue`,
`GET /api/v1/offene-posten`).

saturated.description: At least `limit` accounts matched: more may be overdue than were listed.

accountingd.UeberfaelligesKonto.description: One account with an overdue balance.

kunden_nr.description: The operator's customer number, where recorded.

lf_mp_id.description: The Lieferant's MP-ID the account is kept under.

updated_at.description: When the account's balance last changed.

accountingd.Zahlungszuordnung.description:
The accounts an incoming payment may belong to (`suggest_payment_match`,
`POST /api/v1/payments/match`).

candidates.description: One exact candidate, or up to ten ranked by amount proximity.

tolerance_pct.description:
The tolerance the amount-proximity rung ran with, in percent; absent
when the reference identified the account.

accountingd.Zuordnungskandidat.description: One account a payment may belong to.

confidence.description: `EXACT` for an exact rung; `MEDIUM` or `LOW` for amount proximity.

lf_mp_id.description: The Lieferant's MP-ID the account is kept under.

matched_by.description:
The evidence: an exact rung (`iban`, `end_to_end_id`,
`remittance_token`) or `amount_proximity`.

open_balance_ct.description: The account's open balance in cents.

residual_ct.description: What stays open after booking the payment, in cents (0 settles it).

similarity_score.description: Amount closeness 0–100, only on the amount-proximity rung.

edmd.Abdeckung.description: One state per day for a Marktlokation's series.

bis.description:
Last day answered: the requested `to`, or the last day that has
already ended when `to` lies later. Before `von` when no requested day
has ended yet, and then `tage` is empty.

sparte.description:
`STROM`, `GAS`, `WAERME` or `WASSER` — Gas days are Gastage
(06:00–06:00 Berlin), every other Sparte's calendar days.

tage.description: One entry per day, oldest first.

edmd.Korrektur.description:
One retroactive correction of a stored interval (§ 147 Abs. 1 AO /
§ 146 Abs. 4 AO, GoBD).

obis_code.description: The register corrected; absent when the correction named none.

edmd.Korrekturen.description: The corrections recorded for a Marktlokation in a window, newest first.

saturated.description: `limit` corrections matched: older ones may exist beyond the page.

edmd.Messwert.description: One stored interval of a Marktlokation's series.

obis_code.description: The register's OBIS-Kennzahl, when the delivery named one.

quantity_kwh.description: The quantity in the Sparte's billing unit (kWh; m³ for water).

edmd.Messwerte.description: The version-resolved series of a Marktlokation over a window.

readings.description:
Every register's intervals, oldest first. Empty when nothing was
delivered for the window.

edmd.Messwertqualitaet.description:
The quality of one stored value — the MSCONS Messwertstatus: `MEASURED`
(Messwert), `ESTIMATED` (Prognosewert), `SUBSTITUTED` (Ersatzwert),
`CALCULATED` (Rechenwert), `CORRECTED` (Nachbearbeitungswert),
`PRELIMINARY` (vorläufig), `FAULTY` (fehlerhaft, not billable), `UNKNOWN`.

The variants carry no doc comment of their own: one would make schemars
describe the enum as a `oneOf` of constants where utoipa writes an `enum`,
and the two doors' schemas would differ.

edmd.Note.description:
A quality grade: `A` clean, `B` warnings, `C` errors an Ersatzwert
repairs, `F` blocking — the window is not billable as it stands.

edmd.Qualitaetsbefund.description:
The quality verdict over a window, recomputed from the version-resolved
series by the scorer the ingest and rescore paths run.

algorithm.description: The validation that produced the verdict.

coverage_pct.description: Delivered time inside the window over its length, in percent.

expected_intervals.description: Slots the window holds on the observed grid; absent without one.

gaps_detected.description: Slots of the window no interval delivered.

intervals_consistent.description:
`false`: a slot delivered twice or a span off the grid kept the
content rules from running.

outlier_intervals.description: Interval starts flagged as statistical outliers.

spike_intervals.description: Interval starts above the plant's physical capacity.

zero_run_length.description: The longest run of zeros, in slots.

tag.description: The Berlin calendar day — for Gas the Gastag starting 06:00 that day.

edmd.Tageszustand.description:
What a day of a Marktlokation's series holds: `gemessen` — every slot of
every energy register a measured value; `ersatzwert` — complete, with at
least one Ersatz- or Prognosewert; `korrigiert` — complete, no Ersatzwert,
at least one corrected slot; `fehlt` — at least one slot of an energy
register without a billable value.

einsd.Abrechnungen.description: `list_settlements`' answer: a plant's receipts, the newest month first.

saturated.description: At least `limit` receipts matched: older ones were not listed.

einsd.AbrechnungsErklaerung.description:
`explain_settlement`'s answer: the newest receipt for the month and its
positions as stored.

pflichtzahlung_eur.description: A separate § 52 EEG 2023 Pflichtzahlung owed to the Netzbetreiber.

einsd.Abrechnungsposition.description: One position of a stored settlement receipt.

legal_basis.description: The provision the position rests on.

einsd.AnlageOhneMastr.description: One active plant not registered in the MaStR.

monthly_penalty_eur.description:
§ 52 Abs. 2 EEG 2023: 10 €/kW per month; `None` for a plant under the
pre-2023 regime, which owes no Pflichtzahlung.

regime.description: The rule the plant falls under, as text.

einsd.AnlageRow.description: Stored plant record returned by GET endpoints.

capacity_blocks.description:
A JSON array of `eeg_billing::CapacityBlock` objects; their fields are that crate's and are
not described here.

foerderendedatum.description:
The EEG Förderende, or `NULL` for a plant that has none.

§ 25 Abs. 1 EEG 2023 dates the EEG claim in years. § 8 KWKG does not: it
measures the Zuschlag in Vollbenutzungsstunden (Abs. 1–3) and caps each
calendar year separately (Abs. 4), and both are counters against
generation. A KWK plant therefore has no calendar Förderende and this is
`NULL` for it — `kwk_max_kwh` is what ends its Zuschlag.

foerderung_alert_sent_at.description: When the 180-day Förderende alert was emitted; NULL until it is.

gebotstermin.description: The Gebotstermin of the Zuschlag (§ 100 Abs. 37 EEG 2023).

kwk_bimschg_genehmigung.description: § 6 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 lit. c aa KWKG — BImSchG-Genehmigung erteilt am.

kwk_bmwk_feststellung.description: § 7 Abs. 1 Satz 2 KWKG — whether the BMWK Feststellung is published.

kwk_verbindliche_bestellung.description: § 6 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 lit. c bb KWKG — verbindliche Bestellung am.

sect9_begrenzung_60.description: § 9 Abs. 2 Satz 1 Nr. 2 lit. b / Nr. 3 — 60 % Wirkleistungsbegrenzung.

sect9_fernsteuerbarkeit.description: § 9 Abs. 2 Satz 1 Nr. 1 / Nr. 2 lit. a — ferngesteuerte Reduzierung.

speicher_option.description:
§ 19 Abs. 3b / 3c EEG 2023 — `KEINE` | `ABGRENZUNG` | `PAUSCHAL`. Anlage 1
Nr. 2 Satz 3 moves a plant claiming either option onto the
Jahresmarktwert whatever its vintage.

wechselrichterleistung_va.description: Wechselrichterleistung in VA, for the Abs. 2 Satz 4 Steckersolar carve-out.

wind_guetefaktor_reevaluations.description:
A JSON array of `eeg_billing::wind::GuetefaktorReeval` objects; their fields are that crate's and are
not described here.

zuschlag_datum.description: Date of the BNetzA award notification.

total_monthly_penalty_eur.description: The sum of `monthly_penalty_eur` over the plants that owe one.

einsd.AuslaufendeAnlagen.description:
`list_expiring`'s answer: active plants whose Förderung ends within
`horizon_days`, the earliest Förderende first.

einsd.SettlementReceipt.description:
One settlement receipt as the history lists it: an original and the
correction that superseded it are two rows for one month, told apart by
`is_correction` / `correction_of` — without them the history reads as a
double payment.

error_detail.description:
Why a settlement that paid nothing did not — the developer text beside
`status`.

faelligkeitsdatum.description: § 26 Abs. 1 EEG 2023: the payment's due date.

status.description:
`calculated`, `price_missing`, `no_data`, `error`, `foerderung_beendet`,
`jahreskontingent_erschoepft`, `sanctioned`, `kein_anspruch`, `unknown`
or `gehalten` — a stable code, worded by the reader's catalogue.

einsd.UnabgerechneteAnlagen.description: `list_unsettled_plants`' answer: active plants with no receipt for the month.

marktd.Angaben.description: The NB's Angaben of the bündel no BO4E object carries — one dated row.

marktd.Kante.description:
One edge of the bündel valid on the Stichtag, half-open
`[valid_from, valid_to)`.

marktd.Lokationsbuendel.description:
The Lokationsbündel of a Marktlokation on a Stichtag — the read model
behind the Geschäftsdatenanfrage answers 55035 / 55095 / 55060 (UTILMD AHB
Strom 2.2 Kap. 9.5). Its wire is [`MaloLokationsbuendel`]'s, which makod
reads with `deny_unknown_fields`, so it carries no field that type lacks;
the Lokationsbündelstruktur's wording is [`lokationsbuendelstrukturen`].

oneOf.description: The NB's Angaben row covering the Stichtag.

lokationsbuendelcodes.description:
Every distinct `lokationsbuendelcode` the bündel's edges carry; more
than one is a graph that disagrees with itself.

objekte.description: Every object reached, the Marktlokation itself first.

stichtag.description: The date every edge and the Angaben row are resolved for.

zaehler.description: The Zähler of the bündel's Messlokationen.

zuordnungen.description: Every edge valid on the Stichtag that reached them.

bezeichnung.description: Its Bezeichnung in the Codeliste der Lokationsbündelstrukturen.

marktd.Lokationsbuendelstrukturen.description:
The Codeliste der Lokationsbündelstrukturen (EDI@Energy, BDEW V1.0,
31.03.2023), as `rubo4e::lokationsbuendel::STRUKTUREN` carries it.

bilanzierungsgebiet.description:
Bilanzierungsgebiet EIC code extracted from `data.bilanzierungsgebiet`.
Used by `processd` NB check 4 as primary source; falls back to `malo_grid` when absent.

bilanzierungsmethode.description:
Billing mode extracted from `Marktlokation.bilanzierungsmethode`.

Values: `"RLM"` | `"SLP"` | `"TLP_GEMEINSAM"` | `"TLP_GETRENNT"` | `"PAUSCHAL"` | `"IMS"`.
`"RLM"` → `netzbilanzd` includes Leistungspreis position (`spitzenleistung_kw` required).
`"SLP"` → Arbeitspreis only.

data.description:
Validated BO4E `Marktlokation` payload in canonical camelCase form.
Schema is enforced on every `PUT` — enum fields like `bilanzierungsmethode`
and `netzebene` are rejected with 422 if they contain unknown values.

energierichtung.description:
BO4E `Energierichtung`, named from the grid's point of view:
`"EINSP"` = generation (feeds the grid), `"AUSSP"` = consumption.

fallgruppe.description:
Gas GaBi RLM Fallgruppe (`data["fallgruppenzuordnung"]`) — determines GaBi billing
category. Values: `GABI_RLM_MIT_TAGESBAND` | `GABI_RLM_OHNE_TAGESBAND` |
`GABI_RLM_IM_NOMINIERUNGSERSATZVERFAHREN`. Required for Gas MMM settlement routing.

fernsteuerbar.description:
§14a EnWG „Status der Fernsteuerbarkeit" (`true` = technisch fernsteuerbar,
`false` = nicht fernsteuerbar). Populated from UTILMD `CCI+7037` Z97/Z96.

netzebene.description:
Voltage/pressure level extracted from `data.netzebene` — a BO4E
`Netzebene` wire value (`"NSP"`, `"MSP"`, `"HSP"`, `"HSS"`, `"MSP_NSP_UMSP"`, …).
Available immediately on write; no separate grid provisioning needed.

regelzone.description:
Regelzone EIC code (`Marktlokation.regelzone`) — maps to the ÜNB for MABIS IFTSTA 21000
routing and Redispatch 2.0 Stammdaten forwarding (VNB → ÜNB).

data.description:
Validated BO4E `Messlokation` payload in canonical camelCase form.
`_typ` is auto-injected on write; enum fields validated on write.

netzebene_messung.description: Voltage/pressure level at the metering point (`Messlokation.netzebeneMessung`).

regelzone.description:
Regelzone EIC code extracted from `standorteigenschaften.eigenschaftenStrom[0].regelzone`.
Maps this MeLo to the ÜNB for Redispatch 2.0 Stammdaten routing.

standorteigenschaften.description:
Full BO4E `Standorteigenschaften` JSONB — carries `StandorteigenschaftenStrom`
(regelzone, bilanzierungsgebietEic) and `StandorteigenschaftenGas` (druckstufe).
Required for Redispatch 2.0 `NetworkConstraintDocument` and Gas billing zones.

data.description:
Full BO4E MESSLOKATION payload.

The BO4E schema version is **not** a request field: it is provenance,
and only the server knows which series it parsed the payload under. It
is returned on the `GET`.

marktd.MsbRahmenvertrag.description:
An MSB framework-contract record **as stored**.

The natural key is `(tenant, sparte, nb_mp_id, msb_mp_id, valid_from)` —
upserts are idempotent on it and keep the `id` stable.

`vertrag` reads back as opaque JSON, the way every stored BO4E document in
mako does: a row may predate the current schema series. What goes *in* is
[`MsbRvUpsertRequest`], gated.

fassung.description:
Contract text edition. Gas: `KoV XV Anlage 8` unless named otherwise
(legacy: `BK7-17-026`). Strom: as the parties name it, or absent.

version.description: Optimistic-locking version, incremented on every successful write.

marktd.MsbRvBefund.description: What the registry says about one (Sparte, NB, MSB, day).

abgeschlossen.description:
`true` only when a contract with status `abgeschlossen` is valid on
`datum`.

oneOf.description: The contract covering `datum`, when one does.

marktd.MsbRvStatus.description: Lifecycle state of an MSB framework contract.

marktd.MsbRvUpsertRequest.description:
The `PUT /api/v1/msb-rahmenvertraege` body.

Separate from [`MsbRahmenvertrag`] because the two directions are not
symmetric: what is **written** must cross the BO4E gate, and what is
**read** is whatever was stored.

fassung.description:
Contract text edition. Absent on a Gas row stores [`FASSUNG_GAS`];
absent on a Strom row stores nothing.

id.description: Optional: an id to keep stable. Absent → allocated on insert.

sparte.description:
`STROM` or `GAS` — required: the NB holds one MP-ID per Sparte, and a
contract of one Sparte never answers the other's lookup.

vertrag.description:
The BO4E `Vertrag` (vertragsart `RAHMENVERTRAG`), crossing
[the gate](mako_markt::bo4e::decode) as it deserialises.

Absent stores the empty object the column defaults to, not `null`.

marktd.Obis.description: One OBIS-Kennzahl of the Marktlokation with its Verwendungszwecke.

objektcode.description:
BO4E `lokationsbuendelObjektcode` — the object's position in the
Lokationsbündelstruktur.

marktd.Objekttyp.description: The kind of object in a Lokationsbündel.

marktd.PriCatVersionSummary.description: One entry in the PRICAT version history list.

valid_to.description: End of validity period, or `null` for open-ended.

marktd.Register.description: The Wertegranularität of one register of a Zähler.

expected_version.description:
Optimistic-locking guard: the version the caller last read. When
supplied and stale, the update fails with a version-conflict problem
response instead of overwriting.

marktd.Verfahren.description: The Verfahren of a normiertes Profil.

marktd.VersorgungsStatusHistorie.description: One page of a Marktlokation's supply-state history, newest first.

total.description: Every change recorded for the Marktlokation, not only this page's.

marktd.VersorgungsStatusHistoryResponse.description: One supply-state change of a Marktlokation.

valid_from.description: The instant this state became active (RFC 3339).

zuordnungen.description: The assignment list as it stood at `valid_from`.

marktd.VersorgungsStatusResponse.description: The VersorgungsStatus of a Marktlokation — now, or as it stood on a date.

eog_seit.description: Start of the running Ersatz-/Grundversorgung (§38/§36 EnWG), if any.

lf_mp_id.description:
The single active Lieferant, when there is exactly one.

Derived from `zuordnungen` and **absent on a tranchierte
Marktlokation**, where no single supplier exists — read `zuordnungen`
there rather than treating the omission as „unsupplied".

lf_mp_id_next.description:
The single announced Lieferant, when exactly one Anmeldung is pending.
Derived, with the same caveat as `lf_mp_id`.

updated_at.description:
When this state was written (RFC 3339) — for a state read `at` a date,
when that historic state became active.

zuordnungen.description:
Every Lieferant holding a share of this Marktlokation — the authoritative
answer to „who supplies it". A tranchierte Marktlokation carries several.

marktd.Zaehler.description: A Zähler of one of the bündel's Messlokationen.

marktd.Zuordnung.description: One Lieferant's share of a Marktlokation.

lf_mp_id.description: MP-ID of the Lieferant holding this share.

process_id.description: The process that wrote this assignment.

prozent.description: The share in percent — `100` for an untranchierte Marktlokation.

zuordnungsbeginn.description: Zuordnungsbeginn — the Lieferbeginn of this assignment.

marktd.Zuordnungsstatus.description: Whether a Zuordnung is announced (Anmeldung in flight) or running.
